# Parameters
sql_pool_name = "ruicunha-contoso-flavor3-ondemand"  # e.g., myworkspace
database_name = "master"           # e.g., mydb

# Build the JDBC URL for managed identity
jdbc_url = f"jdbc:sqlserver://{sql_pool_name}.sql.azuresynapse.net:1433;" \
           f"database={database_name};" \
           "encrypt=true;" \
           "trustServerCertificate=false;" \
           "hostNameInCertificate=*.sql.azuresynapse.net;" \
           "authentication=ActiveDirectoryMsi"

# Define the query
query = "SELECT * from sys.tables"

# Read the data using Spark
df = spark.read \
    .format("jdbc") \
    .option("url", jdbc_url) \
    .option("query", query) \
    .option("driver", "com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver") \
    .load()

# Show the result
df.show(truncate=False)
